items.title: End of an era: Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B) said Friday that Warren Buffett will step down as chairman, effective immediately, and transition to the role of chairman emeritus. PNC Asset Management Group CIO Amanda Agati and Aptus Capital Advisors Head of Equity and Portfolio Manager David Wagner join Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss Buffett's departure and his lasting impact on investors.

items.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chair, succeeded by his son
items.summary: Warren Buffett is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B) — to be replaced by his son Howard — after holding the position since 1970. He will be transitioning into a chairman emeritus role. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Washington Crossing Advisors senior portfolio manager Chad Morganlander to react to this announcement.

items.title: Legendary Investor Warren Buffett Is Resigning as Berkshire Chairman
items.summary: Warren Buffett is stepping away from the company he built over six decades into a near-trillion-dollar empire, and the man now holding the keys has already made a $23 billion bet that reveals exactly where Berkshire is headed next.

items.title: Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Chair, Ending Six-Decade Run
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. founder Warren Buffett is stepping down as the company's chairman to be replaced by his son Howard, effectively ending roughly six decades at the helm of the conglomerate.  Bloomberg Intelligence Senior P&C Insurance Analyst Matt Palazola discusses the move and Buffett's legacy with the company.

items.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
items.summary: Influential US billionaire investor Warren Buffett stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, the conglomerate announced Friday.Buffett's resignation is "effective immediately," although he will remain a member of the board of directors as chairman emeritus, Berkshire Hathaway said in a statement.
